relevant_original_rows.question: 8개 TS별로 CR이 얼마나 발생했는지 비교해줘. 표준화 활동이 가장 집중된 TS를 파악하고 싶어
relevant_original_rows.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

relevant_original_rows.question: TS별로 관련된 Agreement 수를 요약해줘. 합의가 가장 많이 이루어진 TS가 어디인지 파악하고 싶어
relevant_original_rows.cypher: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] RETURN sp.specNumber, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount ORDER BY agrCount DESC

relevant_original_rows.question: CR이 가장 많이 발생한 TS Top 5와 각 TS의 Section 수를 비교해줘. 복잡도와 변경 빈도의 상관관계를 보고 싶어
relevant_original_rows.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec {specNumber: ts}) RETURN ts, crCount, count(sec) AS sectionCount ORDER BY crCount DESC

relevant_original_rows.question: 회사별로 8개 TS에 제출한 전체 CR 건수를 보여줘. 주요 플레이어가 누구인지 파악하고 싶어
relevant_original_rows.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.201','38.202','38.291'] MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN co.companyName, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 15

relevant_original_rows.question: TS별 CR 건수와 Agreement 건수를 비교해줘. 어떤 TS가 합의 대비 변경이 많은지 보고 싶어
relevant_original_rows.cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215'] WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr2:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp2:Spec) WHERE sp2.specNumber = ts RETURN ts, crCnt, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCnt ORDER BY crCnt DESC
